title: Nine Frames of Light
subtitle: 摄影与影像 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 摄影与影像（文学艺术与体育·摄影与影像）
meta: 主题语境：摄影与影像（文学艺术与体育·摄影与影像）　|　核心词汇：camera　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 camera 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my mother was sent to hold ① a camera she could not load, and she said the loading was the whole of the lesson. The ② camera, meaning the box and not the film, was nine frames and was carried by whoever came last; a camera, she said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ camera in that studio had the same lens, and the ④ camera at the front, meaning the one the photographer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever loaded properly. A camera, my grandmother said, is nine parts light and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the light is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ camera was the whole of the picture, meaning the image it made and not the box. The ⑥ camera, meaning the picture and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody poses for and nobody questions; a camera, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a box and a picture. She said the picture is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ camera had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the lens. The ⑧ camera of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine frames and eleven years of holding; a camera, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ camera I remember is the one at the front, which was broken in 1977 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ camera, my grandmother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being used; every camera, she said, is a picture that has agreed to look like a box. She said the picture was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 照相机；摄像机
B. n. 相机（指那个机子本身，与胶卷相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold a camera 端着／拿着相机
D. n. 相机（指工作室里每一台）
E. n. 相机（指前面那一台）
F. n. 相机（抽象：它拍出的那张照片）
G. n. 那张照片（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a camera she could not load
The camera, meaning the box and not the film
camera was the whole of the picture
the camera had become a photograph in a report
The camera of the whole thing
A camera, my grandmother said in 1982

answers.why: hold a camera 意为“端着／拿着相机”，1956 年母亲被派去端一台她装不上胶卷的相机。
camera 意为“相机”，指那个机子本身而不是胶卷，能拍九张，由最后走的人拿着。
camera 指工作室里每一台相机，每一台都是同样的镜头。
camera 指前面那一台（摄影师留的那一台），是唯一有人认真装上胶卷的。
camera 意为“相机”，抽象指它拍出的那张照片，父亲说 camera 就是那张照片的全部。
camera 为抽象用法，指那张照片本身，是一家人人人都摆姿势、却没人质疑的东西。
camera 意为“照相机、摄像机”，到 1972 年这台 camera 成了报告里的一张照片。
camera 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九张底片和十一年的端举。
camera 意为“相机”，我记得的是前面那一台，1977 年摔坏，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
camera 为抽象总称，祖母说相机是唯一会因为被真正使用而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年母亲被派去端一台她装不上胶卷的相机，她说装上胶卷才是这堂课的全部。（hold a camera）
那台相机，指的是那个机子本身而不是胶卷，能拍九张，由最后走的人拿着。（camera）
那个工作室里每一台相机都是同样的镜头。（camera）
前面那台相机，指的是摄影师留的那一台，是唯一有人认真装上胶卷的。（camera）
父亲说 camera 就是那张照片的全部，指的是影像而不是那个机子。（camera）
1982 年祖母说，相机是唯一会因为被真正使用而变好的东西。（camera）
